text: Our Wi-Fi nodes are always awake. If they don't transmit or receive, they sense the channel, right? So they do something always. There is the possibility to put Wi-Fi cards into sleep mode, but that's quite rare in practice. We don't know, we don't do that. Indeed, our Wi-Fi cards. Really, we remember to switch the Wi-Fi when when we don't need it, right? Usually, it's always on interface. There are other technologies that are, for example, Bluetooth, that instead are very good in that respect. In Bluetooth, we have the possibility to put our wireless cards Bluetooth interfaces into sleep mode. They as soon as essentially they are they are not doing anything, they go to sleep. So Bluetooth is very efficient from that point of view. In general, we would like this kind of technologies because if you do not need to transmit traffic or receive traffic, it's really good if your device goes into sleep mode. That means that, of course, in that case, it cannot do anything, right? For for the Wi-Fi, it sleeps. But in this way, we reduce very very much its power consumption because we switch off the transceiver and we may also switch off.
